queries:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost,
         AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / product_price) AS inv_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  WHERE derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND product_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(inv_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv
)
SELECT AVG(inv.avg_cost) AS mean_avg_derived_product_cost,
       AVG(inv.inv_ratio) AS mean_invoice_ratio,
       AVG(inv.inv_ratio - overall.avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio_deviation
FROM inv, overall;
SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(product_price) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING SUM(product_price) <> 0);
SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM (
  SELECT AVG(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / AVG(product_price) AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
);
SELECT invoice_number
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
GROUP BY invoice_number
HAVING AVG(derived_vat_payable * 1.0 / derived_product_cost) > (

FROM Invoice_Line_Items
GROUP BY invoice_number
HAVING SUM(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(product_price) > (SELECT SUM(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(product_price) FROM Invoice_Line_Items);
SELECT AVG(derived_product_cost), AVG(derived_total_cost / product_price)
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
